title: 美国大学生省钱妙招：社区学院起步、奖学金与勤工俭学
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: How much did you and your parents, your family, discuss finances before you made the decision to come to purchase?
segments.zh: 在你决定来上学之前，你和父母、家人讨论过多少财务问题？

segments.en: We had to discuss it a lot, honestly, just because I'm a first-generation student, I give free housing being an RA, so that, because of that, now I don't have to pay for anything in
segments.zh: 说实话，我们讨论了很多，因为我是第一代大学生，我担任RA获得免费住宿，所以现在我不需要支付任何学费，还有FAFSA和TAP补助。

segments.en: school at all with FAFSA and TAP. Did you have to take out any loans to attend school?
segments.zh: 你上学需要贷款吗？第一年需要，但成为RA后就不需要再贷款了，现在我已经在还款了。

segments.en: For my first year I did, but once I became an RA, I didn't have to take out any more loans, so now I've been paying them back.
segments.zh: 我很幸运，父母愿意为我贷款，我自己也承担了一些债务，但他们愿意尽可能多地存钱。

segments.en: I'm fortunate enough that my parents were willing to take out loans for me, and I also am going into a little bit of debt, but they were willing to set aside
segments.zh: 我获得了Excelsior奖学金，但毕业后必须留在纽约，否则就得偿还贷款。

segments.en: like as much money as possible. I got the Excelsior scholarship, so if I meaning after I graduate I have to stay in New York otherwise I'll have to pay the loan back.
segments.zh: 那笔贷款是多少？我想大概是5000美元。

segments.en: And how much is that loan? I think it's like $5,000.
segments.zh: 州外学费确实很高，所以我申请了一些学生贷款，还自己筹办了一场演出，通过演出筹钱来上大学。

segments.en: Out-of-state tuition is definitely a lot, so I took out some student loans and was able to do that pretty easily, and I also put on my own fundraising show, like I produced my own show to raise money
segments.zh: 你通过那场演出筹了多少钱？大约3500美元。

segments.en: to come to college, so yeah, how much did you raise from that? About $3,500, yeah.
segments.zh: 你打算定期这样做吗？是的，我计划每年都在家乡举办，因为很成功，这也能帮我建立自己的奖学金基金。

segments.en: Is this something you're going to be doing regularly, you think? Yeah, I'm planning actually on doing it every year in my hometown since it was so successful, so it kind of helps me build my own scholarship fund a little bit.
segments.zh: 你觉得你会经常这样做吗？是的，我计划每年都在家乡做，因为效果很好，这也能帮我积累一点自己的奖学金基金。
